hero.headline: Aviation Technology Consulting for Airlines & Airports
hero.body: AeroExpert is an independent aviation technology consultancy in the UAE supporting airlines, airports and aviation organisations with PSS, DCS, flight operations systems, airport technology, cybersecurity, digital transformation and technology procurement.

expertise.heading: Aviation Technology Expertise
expertise.body: AeroExpert combines deep operational aviation knowledge with specialist expertise in airline systems, airport infrastructure, cybersecurity, digital transformation and aviation software solutions. We deliver independent, business-driven advice that helps aviation organisations make better technology decisions and achieve measurable results.

uae_it.heading: Aviation IT Consulting in the UAE
uae_it.body: AeroExpert provides aviation IT consulting across the UAE and the wider Middle East region — advising airlines, airports and aviation authorities on IT infrastructure strategy, cloud migration, systems integration, IT governance and cybersecurity. Our advisory is vendor-neutral and grounded in the operational and regulatory realities of aviation.

items.text: IT infrastructure strategy and architecture for airlines and airports
